subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notes the miss of his Guiding Bolt at Ilvara without rancor.
source_quote: I note this without rancor.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama.
source_quote: I was amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum filed and appreciated the Jorlan-Ilvara drama.
source_quote: I filed it, appreciated it, and continued.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum intends to attack Ilvara.
source_quote: I am still going to go ahead and attack her.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum considers Ilvara's death pragmatic and notes the size of the spore cloud.
source_quote: Not ideal," I said, immediately. "How big is the cloud?

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is glad he was standing back during Ilvara's explosion.
source_quote: I was glad I was standing back.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz's body cast Shield before his mind consciously decided to.
source_quote: That's the thing about Shield — it's a reaction, which means the body decides before the mind does.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notes the look on the Drow warriors' faces when his shield ward deflected their bolt.
source_quote: I spent a moment noting the look on their faces.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz catalogues the tactical positioning of the Drow warriors.
source_quote: Three Drow warriors. Crossbow formation. Tactical positions chosen in advance. Someone prepared for this.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes maintaining his Lolth-follower identity is consistent characterization, not lying.
source_quote: You learn to stop thinking of it as lying and start thinking of it as consistent characterization.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz knows what is real about his past, his transformation, and his beliefs about slavery and society.
source_quote: I know what's real. I know what I've left behind and what I haven't and what Menzoberranzan made me and what the Underdark has cost me and what I believe now, privately, about slavery and free people and the basis of any society.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes Asha's belief that he serves Lolth is load-bearing in the current situation.
source_quote: But right now, in this cavern, Asha thinks I serve Lolth, and that belief is load-bearing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz does not care whether Nym gets paid.
source_quote: I don't, particularly.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds the idea of standing in shadow while others fight unacceptable.
source_quote: The idea of standing in a shadow while that happens is — I want to find a precise word — unacceptable.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes the best way for Nym to get paid is to continue fighting and prevent everyone from dying.
source_quote: The best way for you to get paid, then, is to continue the fight and prevent all of us from dying.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observes Nym's expression shift from exasperated professionalism to something more pointed.
source_quote: her expression shifted from exasperated professionalism to something more pointed.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices the T'sarran soldiers are having an unhelpful argument at the tunnel mouth.
source_quote: I can only describe as profoundly unhelpful given the circumstances.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds petty logistical failure aesthetically interesting.
source_quote: There's a category of failure I find almost aesthetically interesting — not the grand collapse, but the petty logistical one.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz identifies himself as an Evoker trained in Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: An Evoker — and I am an Evoker, trained in Menzoberranzan where the destructive arts were considered the only magic worth taking seriously.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes Glabbagool does not deserve the suffering the cavern keeps throwing at him.
source_quote: He doesn't deserve what this cavern keeps throwing at him.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz files the observation that the matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about the fireball.
source_quote: I filed it accordingly.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds that standing in the smoke of his fireball, surrounded by people fighting for him, is what purpose feels like.
source_quote: I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.
